vStorage: Multi-tier cloud storage solution
vStorage is VNG Cloud’s multi-tier cloud storage solution, built to deliver fast, secure, and reliable data access. With support for three storage types – Object, File, and Block – vStorage adapts to a wide range of business needs, from daily operations to complex applications.
For Object Storage, vStorage offers 4 optimized storage tiers: High Performance, Gold, Instant Archive, and Archive. These options help businesses balance performance and cost while meeting various storage demands, including those for AI/ML, backup, media, and enterprise workloads.
Features
High Performance
The High-Performance class is optimized for demanding workloads like AI and data analytics that require low latency and high throughput. With the capacity to handle up to 10,000 requests per IP and rapid data retrieval, you can leverage this storage class for processing and accessing large, complex datasets for tasks such as data science, AI training, and deployment.
Suitable
: AI/ML workload, Data lake

Why Choose vStorage?
Ability of Extension
2 branches in Ho Chi Minh & Hanoi; Dedicate zone; Instantly expand storage (in TB); Ready time <1 minute; Actively work on the portal; No downtime; Capable of auto-scaling.
Absolutely Safe and Secure
Replication = 3 on 3 servers; Encryption when stored to the drive; Decentralization features (ACL, IAM); Whitelist IP; Versioning; Block public access; Tempurl; Cross-region backup.
Simple Administration
Self-service portal; Dashboard with Usage Report, Billing Report, Cost Explorer features; Increase quota automatically; Auto-renew / Postpaid; Easy to manage with vMonitor.
High Speed & Compatibility
10Gbps (scalable) bandwidth; Compatible with S3 SDK, S3 client tool; Supports NFS/SMB protocol on Object Storage.
Cost optimization
5 cloud storage tiers; Lifecycle feature allows data transfer between storage tiers; Most Classes offer 100% free requests and x10 traffic.

VKS: VNGCloud Kubernetes Service
VNGCloud Kubernetes Service (VKS) is a managed Kubernetes service based on the open-source Kubernetes project. This Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution simplifies the deployment and management of containerized applications (Container Orchestration Engine), allowing you to focus on application development and operation.
Features
Multi-AZ Node Group Support
Fully Managed Control Plane
Upstream Kubernetes Versions
Reduced Costs and Increased Reliability
Node Group Auto-Scaling
Node Group Auto-Healing
Enhanced Security
Container Network Interface (CNI) Integration
Native Container Storage Interface (CSI) Integration
Native Load Balancer (NLB/ALB) Integration
Multi-AZ Node Group Support
VKS enables the deployment of worker nodes across multiple Availability Zones. This ensures high availability, strong fault tolerance, and continuous operation of business-critical Kubernetes applications.

Fully Managed Control Plane
VKS will handle the heavy lifting of Kubernetes cluster management, freeing up your time to focus on application development and deployment.

Flexible Scalability Options
The system easily adjusts to handle traffic and workload fluctuations, ensuring applications always achieve optimal performance.
